_comment: Names must match the form's Coordinator dropdown. Emails/phones are NOT stored here (this file is committed) — put them in config/coordinators.local.json (gitignored); see coordinators.local.example.json. 'assignedLodges' = dorms this person is responsible for: a lodge name covers the whole building, 'Lodge:Floor' (First/Second) covers one floor. Drives task contacts, digest scope, and reminders. 'role: overall' = sees everything and is the fallback contact for unassigned lodges. Jacob is both a Hickory coordinator and on the maintenance team; Rob likewise coordinates Hickory and is the housekeeping contact.

departments._comment: Issue category → department coordinators added to that task's contact list. Maintenance team: Joe and Jacob. Housekeeping contact: Rob. Supplies has no dedicated contact — those tasks go to the lodge coordinator only.
